title: Test-Drive Lead Qualification Voice Agent
summary: Call new car enquiries quickly, capture model, budget, exchange and finance needs, book showroom or home test drives and pass ready buyers to a sales consultant.

seo.title: Test-Drive Lead Qualification Voice Agent | VipraTech
seo.description: Voice agent that calls car enquiries, qualifies model, budget, exchange and finance needs, books test drives and transfers ready buyers to sales staff.

designed_for: OEM Digital Sales and Lead Management Lead

problem.intro: New car enquiries arrive from the OEM website, car classifieds, social media forms and walk-in registers at all hours. Buyers compare several brands at once, so the dealer that calls first, understands what they want and books a convenient test drive has an advantage.

pain_points.title: Slow first contact
pain_points.detail: Leads that arrive in the evening or on a busy Sunday wait until the next working day for a call.

pain_points.title: Inconsistent qualification
pain_points.detail: Tele-callers capture model, budget and timeline unevenly, so consultants start each conversation from scratch.

pain_points.title: Test-drive no-shows
pain_points.detail: Bookings without confirmation and reminders leave demo cars and consultants idle.

pain_points.title: Exchange and finance surface late
pain_points.detail: Whether the buyer has a car to exchange or needs a loan comes up late, delaying evaluation and finance approval.

solution.overview: We build a voice agent that calls each new lead soon after it arrives, within calling hours and consent rules. It confirms interest and captures the model and variant, fuel and transmission preference, budget, cash or finance, any car to exchange and the purchase timeline. It answers from your approved model and price sheet, and any request for a discount or special offer goes to a sales consultant. The agent books a showroom or home test drive against demo car and consultant availability, sends the booking and showroom location on WhatsApp with a reminder, and transfers buyers who are ready to talk numbers to a consultant during the call.
capabilities: Calls new leads in Hindi, English and regional languages soon after they arrive
Captures model, variant, fuel, transmission, budget, finance and exchange details
Books showroom or home test drives against demo car and consultant calendars
Sends booking details, brochure and location on WhatsApp, with reminders
Transfers ready buyers to a sales consultant during the call
Answers only from the approved model and price sheet, passing discount requests to sales staff

workflow.title: Receive the lead
workflow.detail: A new lead lands in the CRM from a portal, website or social form, and consent and calling-window checks run.

workflow.title: Call and confirm interest
workflow.detail: The agent calls, introduces itself as an automated assistant and confirms the enquiry.

workflow.title: Qualify
workflow.detail: It captures model, budget, finance, exchange and timeline in a natural conversation.

workflow.title: Decide the next step
workflow.detail: Buyers ready to discuss price or asking for offers are transferred live to a consultant.

workflow.title: Book the test drive
workflow.detail: Other buyers are offered a test-drive slot, confirmed on WhatsApp with a reminder.

workflow.title: Update the CRM
workflow.detail: The lead record, score and call summary are updated and assigned to a consultant.

inputs: New leads from the OEM portal, website, classifieds and social forms
Approved model, variant and price sheet
Demo car calendar and consultant roster
outputs: Qualified lead records with model, budget, finance and exchange details
human_in_the_loop: Price negotiation, discounts, exchange valuation and finance approval are handled by people. The sales manager reviews a sample of calls each week and adjusts scripts and approved answers.
integrations: CRM or DMS lead module, such as Salesforce, Zoho or the OEM lead system
guardrails: Answers from the approved price sheet only, with no discount or delivery commitments
States that it is an automated assistant
Consent, DND and calling-hour checks before every call
Transfers to a person whenever the buyer asks
Scripts reviewed for false urgency and pressure tactics
compliance_notes: Calls and messages follow TRAI commercial communication rules on consent, DND and registered templates.
Scripts avoid false urgency and other practices covered by the CCPA guidelines on dark patterns.
Lead data handled under the DPDP Act 2023.

pilot.scope: One showroom, with leads from two sources such as the OEM website and one classifieds portal, in Hindi and English.
deliverables: Qualification script and approved answer set
Agent connected to the CRM and calendars in test
Live pilot with a QA dashboard

what_we_measure.how: Minutes from lead creation to first call attempt, compared with the current team.
Share of leads with model, budget, finance and exchange captured.
Share of agent-booked test drives that took place.
Consultant rating of lead quality and call summaries.

faqs.q: Will it sound robotic to buyers?
faqs.a: We use natural voices in Hindi, English and regional languages and test them with your sales team before launch. The agent keeps calls short and transfers to a person as soon as the buyer wants detail it should not give.

faqs.q: What does it say about prices and offers?
faqs.a: It reads ex-showroom prices and standard information from your approved sheet. Discounts, exchange bonuses and finance offers are always passed to a consultant.

faqs.q: Our group sells several brands. Can one agent handle them?
faqs.a: Yes. Each brand gets its own approved content and routing, and the agent introduces itself on behalf of the right showroom.

faqs.q: How do leads reach our consultants?
faqs.a: Through your CRM or DMS, with the summary and booking attached, plus a WhatsApp or app notification to the assigned consultant.
